jobs.title: Administration Assistant
jobs.reason: This is a general administrative/executive-support role centred on invoice processing, travel booking, event coordination and office operations — outside the candidate's policy/research/intelligence profile despite the prestigious publisher. FIELD ≤ 2 forces Low; the work is generic admin not tied to a policy or research function.

Hard ineligibility on seniority (Director title) and field mismatch.

jobs.title: Senior Tester
